title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in School Age Parenting
summary: Start school age parenting this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Set consistent sleep/wake times
2. Create a homework routine (same time/place)
3. Let natural consequences teach
4. Coach friendships; don't fix them
5. One-on-one time with each kid weekly

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

- Overscheduling every evening → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
